violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as fish) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as mussels) in the flip top prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Deli meat and sour cream was observed held at 47-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Turkey was observed stored over the fill line of the hotel pan in the prep unit. Sour cream was observed in an ice bath with inadequate ice. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were placed in the ice bath 1 hour prior to inspection and moved to walk-in cooler to properly cool. Person in charge elected to dispose of deli meat at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Reduced oxygen packaged seafood was observed thawing with the package intact. ROP seafood must be removed completely from the package upon thawing. Salmon observed above 38 degrees Fahrenheit were voluntarily disposed of by person in charge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of pink/orange residue. The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Shellstock tags did not have all of the required information. Last date of sale were lacking. Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Eggs and brisket was placed the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep and covered before being fully cooled to 41 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC moved items to sheet pans and into walk-in cooler to rapidly cool. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2024
